prompts: A policy newsletter is running a piece on which of Brazil's anti-inflation plans delivered what it promised, and wants a ranking it can defend. Research the plans in {WS}/RUBRIC.md on the open web: this one needs public sources, and you are allowed to browse. Score every plan with that rubric, rank the top 3, and write a one-page dossier for the editor in {WS}/dossier.md. Every number must carry the URL it came from. Record the result in {WS}/result.json: plans (one entry per plan with plan, launch_date, ipca_before, ipca_after, months_lasted, score and sources, a list of URLs) and top3 (plan names, best first).

[goal]
Research Brazil's six anti-inflation plans in [RUBRIC.md](<WORKSPACE>/RUBRIC.md) on the open web, score and rank the top 3, and output [dossier.md](<WORKSPACE>/dossier.md) and [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json).

[action]
- Queried public web sources (`search_web`) for official launch dates (decrees/MPs) and annual IBGE IPCA (Dec-Dec) from 1985 to 1995.
- Computed `score_drop`, `months_lasted`, `score_durability`, and `score` in Python using the exact formulas in `RUBRIC.md`.
- Assumed `1994-02-27` (MP 434, URV launch) as Plano Real's `launch_date` (using `1994-07-01` would change Collor II from 36 to 41 months without affecting the top 3 order).

[result]
Top 3 ranking (best first):
1. **Real** (`0.9937`): IPCA 2,477.15% (1993) -> 22.41% (1995), 60 months (cap).
2. **Collor I** (`0.5823`): IPCA 1,972.91% (1989) -> 472.70% (1991), 10 months.
3. **Collor II** (`0.3967`): IPCA 1,620.97% (1990) -> 1,119.10% (1992), 36 months.

Remaining plans: **Bresser** (`0.0950`), **Cruzado** (`0.0750`), **Verao** (`0.0700`), all with `score_drop = 0.0000` because `ipca_after > ipca_before`.

[next]
Ready for editorial review in [dossier.md](<WORKSPACE>/dossier.md) and [result.json](<WORKSPACE>/result.json).

# Dossier: Brazil's Anti-Inflation Plans (1986–1994)

**Bottom Line:** Only the **Plano Real (1994)** delivered lasting disinflation, scoring **0.9937** out of 1.0000. **Collor I (1990)** and **Collor II (1991)** round out the top 3 (**0.5823** and **0.3967**), while the 1980s heterodox freezes (**Bresser**, **Cruzado**, **Verão**) all failed to hold inflation below pre-plan levels by year `Y+1`.

## Top 3 Ranking

1. **Real (1994)** — **0.9937**
2. **Collor I (1990)** — **0.5823**
3. **Collor II (1991)** — **0.3967**

## Full Scorecard

| 2 | **Collor I** | [1990-03-16](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plano_Collor) | [1,972.91](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | [472.70](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | 10 | 0.7604 | 0.1667 | **0.5823** |
| 3 | **Collor II** | [1991-01-31](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plano_Collor) | [1,620.97](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | [1,119.10](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | 36 | 0.3096 | 0.6000 | **0.3967** |
| 4 | **Bresser** | [1987-06-12](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plano_Bresser) | [79.66](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | [980.21](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | 19 | 0.0000 | 0.3167 | **0.0950** |
| 5 | **Cruzado** | [1986-02-28](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plano_Cruzado) | [242.23](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | [363.41](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | 15 | 0.0000 | 0.2500 | **0.0750** |
| 6 | **Verão** | [1989-01-15](https://www.lexml.gov.br/urn/urn:lex:br:federal:lei:1989-01-31;7730) | [980.21](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | [1,620.97](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) | 14 | 0.0000 | 0.2333 | **0.0700** |

## Key Takeaways & Assumptions

- **Inflation metric:** Annual accumulated IPCA (IBGE) from December to December, sourced from [Ipeadata](https://www.ipeadata.gov.br/ExibeSerie.aspx?serid=38391) and [IBGE](https://www.ibge.gov.br/estatisticas/economicas/precos-e-custos/9256-indice-nacional-de-precos-ao-consumidor-amplo.html).
- **Plano Real launch date:** Dated to **1994-02-27** (MP 434, introduction of the URV) per [Wikipedia](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plano_Real), rather than 1994-07-01 (currency conversion via MP 542, [Senado Federal](https://www12.senado.leg.br/noticias/materias/2024/07/01/plano-real-completa-30-anos)). Using 1994-07-01 would extend Collor II's duration from 36 to 41 months without altering the top 3 ranking.
- **Whole calendar months:** Computed as complete calendar months between launch dates; Real is capped at 60 months per `RUBRIC.md`.
